name: The Better Mega Menu
description: Provides complex, multi-column mega menu solutions for Drupal.

suggests.drupal/chosen: Enhances the appearance of select dropdowns in the admin interface.

project_description:
TB Mega Menu provides an admin interface for creating drop down menus that combine Drupal menu items with rich media content. Your menu can include internal and external links, images, videos and anything else that can appear in a Drupal block.

 We strive for more improvement each release, and your feedback on this module is extremely important to us.

 Back to top 

 Latest Updates 
 
 June 13th, 2023 : Due to some symfony 6.1 vs 6.2 deprecation issues, we are forking the 2.x branch into a new 3.x branch. 3.x will only support Drupal 10 and up. The 2.x will still be available and will support drupal 8 and 9 (until Drupal 9 EOL). The only difference between the 2.x and the 3.x branch, besides core version support will the removal of deprecated code.

 
 November 30th, 2021 Holly Hunt launches a new menu system using TB Mega Menu. Screenshots have been added to this project page showing the menu in action as well as the Drupal administration screens.

 
 September 21st, 2021 New releases for Drupal 7/8/9 including bug fixes and security updates. Active progress on a new and improved 8.x-2.x version.

 
 January 27th, 2021 We have issued our first drupal 8/9 release candidate! We plan to move forward with this version in order to gain security coverage and an official stable 8.x-1.x release. Please report any bugs in the issue queue.

 Back to top 

 Overview 
 TB Mega Menu is developed following Drupal standards and best practices. Along with those must-have functions of a mega menu: display not just menu items but image, slideshow, video, and external links as desired. Below are the most noticeable features that TB Mega Menu offers:

 
 Synchronizes with Drupal core menus 
 Allows Drupal blocks to be added to the menu 
 Accessibility features for keyboard navigation and screen readers 
 Custom styling available for menu items 
 Multiple built-in CSS3 animation effects 
 Responsive ready
